name: Netlify
label: Netlify API
description: Netlify API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.netlify.com/api-and-cli-guides/api-guides/get-started-with-api/. Operations: deploy_create, deploy_get, deploy_list, deploy_cancel, site_get, site_list, site_delete, listen. Auth secret token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: deploy_create | deploy_get | deploy_list | deploy_cancel | site_get | site_list | site_delete | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'deploy_create'.

schema.label: site_id
schema.description: Netlify site id for deploy_* and site_*. Example: 1d01c82b-xxxx.

schema.label: files
schema.description: deploy_create files map {path: sha1}. Official digest deploy.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: deploy_create, deploy_get, deploy_list, deploy_cancel, site_get, site_list, site_delete, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: Netlify personal access token. Authorization: Bearer.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
